hooks.command: if [ -f .claude/context/PLAN.md ]; then echo '[PM] Project context detected.'; fi; if [ -f .claude/context/MANUSCRIPT_PIPELINE.json ]; then phase=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.claude/context/MANUSCRIPT_PIPELINE.json')); print(f'Phase {d.get(\"current_phase\",0)}/6')" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo "[MP] Manuscript pipeline active ($phase)."; fi; if [ -f .claude/context/PLAN.md ]; then echo 'Run /pm sync for full status.'; fi
